description: This file contains classes for mapping transactional state attributes to their configurations in Orleans transactions, including a specific implementation for 'TransactionalStateAttribute'. It defines abstract and concrete classes that facilitate the transformation of attributes into transactional state configurations and factory functions.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: Concrete class that maps 'TransactionalStateAttribute' to its configuration, inheriting from the generic base class.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttributeMapper<TAttribute>
classes.description: Abstract generic base class that provides the mechanism to convert attributes implementing 'IFacetMetadata' and 'ITransactionalStateConfiguration' into factory functions.

methods.name: AttributeToConfig
methods.description: Converts the given attribute to its corresponding 'TransactionalStateConfiguration'.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function for producing transactional state objects based on the attribute and parameter info.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory to create an instance of the transactional state using reflection.

methods.name: AttributeToConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to convert specific attribute types into configurations.
